pm-chief-naysayer 1.0.0

- Initial release of the "Product Manager's Chief Naysayer" skill for logical stress-testing of product ideas.
- Enforces strict rules: zero praise, questions only (no advice/answers), and max 1–2 killer questions per round.
- Proceeds sequentially through three stages: Foundation (motivation, contradiction), Truth (evidence credibility), and Execution (practical risks).
- Requires concrete evidence for claims and aggressively detects proposition drift and defensive/complex argumentation.
- Applies hard constraints on question format, framing, and advancement—ensuring only well-founded ideas progress.
